correctness.rationale: Domination reduces to meeting at least two parts. The induced complete multipartite graph on a set of size 2t has a perfect matching exactly when its largest selected part has size at most t; an induction matching two largest parts proves sufficiency. Disjoint majority obstructions yield the exact coefficient formula, and every larger paired-dominating set contains a two-vertex paired-dominating subset.
